features.name: Agent 宿主命令执行
features.description: 为 Pi Agent 增加受当前工作区权限模式控制的真实宿主命令执行能力，使其可以运行 npm、node、pnpm 等项目命令，同时保留用户终端与 Pi 虚拟 bash 的边界。

README.md:13:- 使用 `host_exec` 在真实宿主环境运行 `npm`、`pnpm`、`node` 和项目测试；是否需要确认由 composer 中选择的工作区权限模式决定。
README.md:38:        │    ├─ host_exec (login shell, main process, workspace cwd)
README.md:94:- `host_exec` 与 Pi 写入、编辑和 bash 共用工作区权限：`allow-all` 直接执行，`allow-edits`/`allow-reads` 下命令沿用 bash 审批；审批绑定 chat、run、tool call 和原始参数，过期、重复或伪造响应会失败。
README.md:96:- Agent 的 `host_exec` 使用独立的一次性宿主 shell，不接管右侧用户终端。命令在当前用户权限下运行，cwd 固定在 chat 所属工作区，输出有大小与时间上限并作为工具结果返回模型；工作区路径不是 OS 沙盒，命令仍可能访问工作区外资源。
README.md:101:已实现：本地工作区和持久化会话、独立后台运行、模型提供商设置、composer thinking level、按工作区持久化的 Pi 与宿主命令权限、Pi 原生及真实宿主命令工具、工具审批、计划与 `ask_user`、文件浏览、附件读取、公共网页搜索、侧边聊天、真实终端和可扩展右侧面板。
docs/architecture.md:24:            -> project permission mode (allow-reads / allow-edits / allow-all) plus native approval when required
docs/architecture.md:25:            -> host_exec (main-process login shell, real host binaries, same project permission mode)
docs/architecture.md:46:- an Agent `host_exec` tool in main that starts real host commands in a dedicated login shell, resolves its workspace root from the active chat, applies the same `allow-all` / `allow-edits` / `allow-reads` policy as Pi's bash tool, and returns bounded output to the model;
docs/architecture.md:102:Web search runs in Electron main through the local `zhulingyu666/ai-search-mcp` stdio server. Its `search` tool is exposed to Pi as Sailor's stable `web_search` name; `fetch_page` and `research` remain available as supporting tools. The server uses zero-key search engines with regional routing, caching, rate limiting and failover. MCP results are untrusted external content and the renderer only creates links after HTTP(S) validation. Legacy webSearch credentials are not persisted or exposed. Pi's virtual bash follows the workspace permission mode and cannot launch arbitrary host binaries. `host_exec` is the explicit host-process boundary for commands such as `node`, `npm`, `pnpm` and project test/build scripts. It uses the selected login shell in Electron main, starts with the canonical workspace root (or a validated path within it), and returns stdout/stderr, exit status and truncation/timeout state to the tool result. The default output cap is 256 KiB and the default timeout is 300 seconds. `allow-all` runs without per-call approval; `allow-edits` and `allow-reads` request approval under the existing Bash policy. Side chats do not register the tool. The command runs with the current user's privileges; workspace cwd is not an OS sandbox. The interactive terminal remains a separate user-owned PTY, and its live input/output is not shared with the Agent.
docs/architecture.md:118:- `projects`: `{ id, name, rootPath, permissionMode? }[]`; missing permissionMode is read as `allow-all` for legacy projects; new projects also start in `allow-all`; side chats force `allow-reads`;
docs/architecture.md:176:Pi 原生 `bash` 继续使用 just-bash，不能调用本机 pnpm、Node 或编译器。需要真实宿主命令时使用 main 进程的独立 `host_exec` 工具；它按 chat 解析工作区、复用 composer 当前权限模式、受超时与输出上限约束，且不共享用户手动终端。宿主命令使用当前用户权限运行，工作区 cwd 本身不构成 OS 沙盒。
docs/architecture.md:180:`PiRunner` uses the project permission mode resolved from chatId and frozen at run start (`allow-reads`, `allow-edits` or `allow-all`), with `allow-all` as the new and legacy-project default; side chats force `allow-reads` and a read-only active tool allowlist. Native write/edit/bash/host_exec approvals are registered in main by approval ID, chat ID, run ID, call ID and tool name, expire after five minutes, and are consumed once before continuation. The runtime's saved call is authoritative; renderer responses cannot replace tool parameters. Reboot, cancellation and abandoning a pending turn invalidate approvals. IPC accepts the native write/edit/bash/host_exec approval names. UI history validates against Pi's exported builtin schemas; retired static tool parts become dynamic history parts with no executor.
